summary: Covetous tactics now runs, but Knight still matches 1757/1814 screens. At step 1757 JavaScript applies fire-trap damage to an aligned cleric while C proceeds to another distfleeck call. The extra damage is a distinct trap hit, not a duplicated invocation; the preceding movement/state discrepancy and corresponding C actor remain unresolved.

source.branch: At RNG index 106318, C calls distfleeck rn2(5)=3 while JS calls trapeffect_fire_trap d(2,4)=6. The JS aligned cleric 2321 moves from (24,14) to (25,13) before one m_move→postmov→mintrap sequence. The movement-state cause is not yet established.
callers: monmove.c dochug calls tactics, then distfleeck, then m_move; postmov handles the destination trap. mon.c mfndpos supplies the source candidate-square rules implemented by JS mfndposCore.
dependencies: Accepted getpos.c collection/cycling now includes menu selection and cancellation, source coordinate descriptions and exact area-filter lifetime. Five independent recordings match. VIEW and other location-family entry recordings remain open in GOALS.json.

Accepted pager do_screen_description now collects all source symbol families and uses canonical stored-glyph map_glyphinfo. Its lookup coordinates differ from the encoded-prefix decode at (0,0); pet and hero overrides, Rogue colors and NOOVERRIDE order are verified. getpos_menu, displayed-glyph accessibility, cursor auto-description and clicked lookup recording entries remain open in GOALS.json.

Three independent recordings cover movement menu/count and colon look. Other unresolved source/coverage defects remain separate: make_stoned/minstapetrify/do_stone_mon; hero/monster stoning directions, corpse-weapon and attack-triggered golem entries; passive cold/fire/electricity/paralysis and lethal recovery; eating/non-food cleanup; skinback artifact-light radius and rare armor/Eyes-of-the-Overworld cleanup.

Liquid-specific entry recordings and exceptional partial rloc routes remain open; trap.c inventory-chain calls and mon.c deal_with_overcrowding remain named discarded-call gaps. GOALS.json preserves open print_dungeon, hitmu, mfind0, goto_level, minliquid, creation/flash, pickup and achievement entry families rather than treating supporting unit tests as their completion.

Hidden-attacker witnesses require eligible placement on objects or water, actual hidden state and an executed hitmu. Plain or qualified monster creation alone does not establish that entry; independent hidden-trapper and invisible-newt recordings establish creation/flash only.

The m_move/mdisplacem dispatch, combat state and projected movement corrections have matching Tengu relocation recordings. Displacement, mail, worm and exceptional dedicated-mover entry recordings remain open in GOALS.json. Covetous admission now reaches the complete wizard.c tactics family through dochug.

Safe monster scans, deferred-transition continuation and Hell-bat creation speed resolve the earlier step 1742 failure. Region upkeep keeps harmful gas and unknown callbacks explicit; its nonempty-region recording coverage remains separate.

The which_arti-through-tactics family and result-bearing relocation dependencies are implemented. Two independent peaceful master-lich recordings reach harassment, including mnexto relocation; healing and hero/floor/other-monster artifact entries remain unrecorded. Relocation preserves action/display RNG and source redraw order. Worm, shop, trap, occupation and attached-hero relocation restrictions and the named-expulsion gap remain explicit.

The ordinary ice-vortex expels caller now delegates old/new monster-square redraws to mnexto and redraws only the hero square afterward. Planning suppresses live redraws. This removes the duplicate destination draw introduced when mnexto gained its source relocation core; the fixed hallucination session matches again.

evidence: The combined 40823c47 development artifacts preserve all 42 previously passing sessions and 11339 matching screens. Knight gains 141 positional RNG matches (106194→106335), with screens and cursors unchanged at 1757. No new screen gain is claimed.

The saved candidate scan places the first RNG, screen and cursor divergence at 1757. It emits 1758 screens before the later substituted-monster-attack refusal; that refusal is not the first source cause. The C annotation distfleeck names the next recorded draw rather than proving that function defective.

Bounded isolated run-WRs3cV and the earlier run-5jHZR8 trace identify JS aligned cleric m_id2321 and fire trap (25,13). There is exactly one m_move→postmov→mintrap→trapeffect_fire_trap chain for this hit. The prior fire-trap draws belong to another actor; deleting a duplicate trap call is a falsified explanation.

Compare the actor state and candidate-square selection before this move against C monmove.c m_move and mon.c mfndpos, including priest dispatch, trap knowledge and positions changed by earlier tactics. Actual ispriest/shrine/target fields and correspondence to the C actor still need proof; do not infer the owner from the RNG annotation alone.
C trap.c trapeffect_fire_trap draws d(2,4) before checking fire resistance, so a different resistance value alone cannot explain omission of this initial damage draw.

Retained counter-evidence for the resolved step 1742 issue: the earlier bat had spent its own movement ration, and the two distfleeck calls described one action. Vampire shapechange does not apply the Hell-bat creation adjustment.
